```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(stringr)
library(lmerTest)
library(broom.mixed)
```

load in crypt metadata and atrributions 
```{r}
crypt_metadata<-read.csv('../Data/biopsy_metadata.csv')
crypt_signature_attributions<-read.csv('../Data/crypt_signature_attributions.csv')
```

## a : reconstruct background mutation rates :
perform for sbs mutations
```{r}
## annotate biopsies and patients :
crypt_signature_attributions<-left_join(crypt_signature_attributions, crypt_metadata,by=c('patient','biopsy'))%>%
  group_by(biopsy)%>%
  
  # annotate biopsies by colibactin status :
  mutate(biopsy_colibactin_pos=sum(SBS88>0 & ID18>0,na.rm=T)>1,     # both present in at least 2 crypts
         SBS89_ID25_biopsy_pos=sum(SBS89>0 & ID25>0,na.rm=T)>1)%>%  # both present in at least 2 crypts
  ungroup()%>%
  group_by(patient)%>%
  mutate(patient_colibactin_pos=(sum(biopsy_colibactin_pos,na.rm=T)>0),   # at least one biopsy positive
         patient_SBS89_ID25_pos=sum(SBS89_ID25_biopsy_pos,na.rm=T)>0,     # at least one biopsy positive

  # adjust SBS and ID burdens for sensitivity derived from coverage and median vaf :  
         across(starts_with('SBS'),~as.numeric(.x) /sensitivitySBS),
         snv_muts=as.numeric(snv_muts)/sensitivitySBS,
         indel_muts=as.numeric(indel_muts)/sensitivityID,
  
         SBSBackground=SBS1+SBS5+SBS18)  # calculate background SBS mutations

## create dataframe for assessing those individuals who are colibactin negative, SBSB89/ID25 neg and histologically normal
background_df<-crypt_signature_attributions %>%
  filter(cohort!='IBD'&colonoscopy_finding != 'FAP' & SBS89_ID25_biopsy_pos==FALSE &patient_colibactin_pos==FALSE) age_location_lmer_ml<-lmer(SBSBackground ~ age:location+ (1 | patient),data = background_df) 

## construct summary dataframe :
sbs_conf <- as.data.frame(confint(age_location_lmer_ml)) %>%
  rownames_to_column("location") %>%
  rename(lower_ci = `2.5 %`, upper_ci = `97.5 %`)

sbs_summary <- tidy(age_location_lmer_ml, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
  filter(str_detect(term, "age:location")) %>%
  mutate(location = str_remove(term, "age:location"),
    mut_type = "SBS",
    across(c(estimate, conf.low, conf.high), round, 0),
    text = paste0(estimate, " mutations/year [", conf.low, ", ", conf.high, "]")) %>%
  select(mut_type,location, Estimate = estimate, lower_ci = conf.low, upper_ci = conf.high, text)
# Store intercept value
sbs_summary$intercept <- round(summary(age_location_lmer_ml)$coefficients['(Intercept)','Estimate'],0)
```

repeat for indels
```{r}
## lmer for indel rates :
indel_age_location_lmer_ml<-lmer(indel_muts ~ age:location + (1| patient), data=background_df)

## construct summary dataframe :
id_conf<-as.data.frame(confint(indel_age_location_lmer_ml))%>%
  rownames_to_column(var='location')%>%
  rename(lower_ci = `2.5 %`, upper_ci = `97.5 %`)

id_summary<-tidy(indel_age_location_lmer_ml, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
  filter(str_detect(term, "age:location")) %>%
  mutate(location = str_remove(term, "age:location"),
    mut_type = "ID",
    across(c(estimate, conf.low, conf.high), round, 1),
    text = paste0(estimate, " mutations/year [", conf.low, ", ", conf.high, "]")
  ) %>%
  select(mut_type, location, Estimate = estimate, lower_ci = conf.low, upper_ci = conf.high, text)
# Store intercept value
id_summary$intercept <- round(summary(indel_age_location_lmer_ml)$coefficients['(Intercept)','Estimate'],0)
```

combine the above outputs
```{r}
## tabulate all the mutational rates :
sbs_summary$mut_type='SBS'
id_background_summary$mut_type='ID'
background_rates_df<-rbind(sbs_summary,id_summary)%>%
  dplyr::select(location, mut_type,Estimate)
```

# b : construct mutational age plot :
## i  construct mutational age dataframe
```{r}
## create a dataframe for mutational age analysis
mutational_age_df<-left_join(crypt_metadata,crypt_signature_attributions, by=c('patient','biopsy'))%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  # adjust all for sensitvity
  mutate(across(starts_with('SBS'), ~.x / sensitivitySBS),
         indel_muts = as.numeric(indel_muts) / sensitivityID)%>%
  
  # calculate per crypt totals for mutational signatures :
  mutate(SBS=SBS1+SBS5+SBS18+SBS88+SBS89, ID=indel_muts)%>%
  dplyr::select(patient, biopsy,cohort,crypt,location,site, SBS, ID, age,biopsy_colibactin_pos,SBS89_ID25_biopsy_pos) %>%
  
  # convert to longer format to facilitate plotting below
  pivot_longer(cols=c("SBS", "ID"),names_to='mut_type',values_to='mutation')%>%
  
  # join with brackground rates to determine mutational age :
  left_join(background_rates_df,by=c('location','mut_type')) %>%
  mutate(mutational_age=mutation / Estimate)

```

### ii : construct dataframe for plotting mutational age
```{r}
## construct plot for mutational age
plot_mutational_age<-mutational_age_df%>%
  group_by(biopsy,mut_type) %>%
  summarise(mutational_age=mean(mutational_age,na.rm=T),
            mut_type=first(mut_type),
            age    = min(age,na.rm=T),
            site=dplyr::first(site),
            cohort=first(cohort),
            crypts = n(),
            biopsy_colibactin_pos=any(biopsy_colibactin_pos),
            SBS89_ID25_biopsy_pos=any(SBS89_ID25_biopsy_pos),
            .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(signature_anotation=case_when(biopsy_colibactin_pos==TRUE ~'colibactin_mutagenesis',
                                      SBS89_ID25_biopsy_pos==TRUE ~ 'SBS89_ID25_mutagenesis', 
                                      .default='only_background_mutagenesis'))%>%
  
  # to facilitate plot, turn Indels into negative numbers :
  mutate(mutational_age=case_when(mut_type=='ID' ~ -1*mutational_age, TRUE ~ mutational_age))%>%

  # format variables into relevant factors :
  arrange(biopsy)%>%
  mutate(mut_type=ifelse(str_detect(mut_type,'SBS'),'SBS','Indel'),
         mut_type=factor(mut_type, levels=c('SBS','Indel')),
         site=factor(site,levels=c('Left','Right')),
         patient=factor(str_extract(biopsy,'PD\\d{5}')),
         bar_end=mutational_age*1.05)
  

## create labels for x-axis
age_labs <- mutational_age_df %>%
  distinct(biopsy, age, location) %>%
  arrange(location, age) %>%
  mutate(age=round(age,digits=0), 
         age_label = ifelse(age != lag(age), age, ""),
         age_label = replace_na(age_label, "2")) %>%
  arrange(age)

age_labels <- setNames(age_labs$age_label, age_labs$biopsy)
age_labels <- age_labels[age_labels != ""]
age_breaks <- names(age_labels)
```

### iii Figure 2.A : Mutational Age
```{r}

## plot the mutational age:
svg("/Users/hm14/Downloads/mutational_age_colibactin_frequency_25feb.svg", width = 16, height = 8, bg = "transparent")

ggplot(plot_mutational_age, aes(y = mutational_age, x = fct_reorder(biopsy, age), fill = signature_anotation)) +
  
  # plot annotation for cohort : 
 geom_point(data=plot_mutational_age[plot_mutational_age$mut_type=='SBS',],aes(fct_reorder(biopsy, age),y=-1.5,shape = cohort), colour = "black",size=2)+
  geom_point(data=plot_mutational_age[plot_mutational_age$mut_type=='Indel',],aes(fct_reorder(biopsy, age),y=5,shape = cohort), colour = "black",size=2)+
  
  # plot bars for mutational age
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.7) +
  
  # facet by location and by mutation typer
  facet_grid(mut_type ~ site, scales = "free", space = "free_x", switch = "y", 
             labeller = labeller(mut_type = as_labeller(c(Indel = "ID 'Mutational Age' [years]", SBS = "SBS 'Mutational Age' [years]")),
      site = as_labeller(c(Right = "Colon Right Side",Left='Colon Left Side')))) +
  
  # stipulate scales :
  scale_y_continuous(labels = abs) +
  scale_x_discrete(breaks = age_breaks, labels = age_labels) +
  scale_shape_manual(breaks=c('Normal','IBD'), values=c(NA,1), labels=c('','Inflammatory Bowel Disease'))+
  scale_fill_manual(
    breaks = c("colibactin_mutagenesis", "SBS89_ID25_mutagenesis", "only_background_mutagenesis"),
    values = c("hotpink3", "#5cdf02ff", "grey70"),
    labels = c("Colibactin Mutagenesis", "ID25 / SBS89 Mutagenesis", "Only Background Mutagenesis")
  ) +
  
  # stipulate labels :
  labs(x = "Chronological Age of Donor at Time of Biopsy Acquisition [years]",
    fill = "Mutational Processes Present",
    shape=''
  ) +
  
  # format plot 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14.5, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.placement.y = "outside",
    strip.placement.x = "inside",
    panel.spacing.x = unit(0.9, "cm"),
    panel.spacing.y = unit(0, "cm"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    strip.text.x = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    strip.text.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"))

dev.off()
```
### iv : perform comparisons of mutational age:
```{r}
## create dataframe for comparison
compare_mutation_age_df<-mutational_age_df%>%
  select(-mutation, -Estimate)%>%
  pivot_wider(names_from=mut_type,values_from=mutational_age)

# compare sbs and id mutational ages for left colon :
left_sbs_mut_age_ml=summary(lmer(SBS~biopsy_colibactin_pos+(1|cohort)+(1|patient),data=compare_mutation_age_df[compare_mutation_age_df$site=='Left',]))$coefficients
left_id_mut_age_ml=summary(lmer(ID~biopsy_colibactin_pos+(1|cohort)+(1|patient),data=compare_mutation_age_df[compare_mutation_age_df$site=='Left',]))$coefficients

# compare sbs and id mutational ages for right colon :
right_sbs_mut_age_ml=summary(lmer(SBS~biopsy_colibactin_pos+(1|cohort)+(1|patient),data=compare_mutation_age_df[compare_mutation_age_df$site=='Right',]))$coefficients
right_id_mut_age_ml=summary(lmer(ID~biopsy_colibactin_pos+(1|cohort)+(1|patient),data=compare_mutation_age_df[compare_mutation_age_df$site=='Right',]))$coefficients


print(paste0('Left SBS mutational age : ', round(left_sbs_mut_age_ml[2],digits=0), ' [', round(left_sbs_mut_age_ml[2]-1.96*left_sbs_mut_age_ml[4],digits=0),', ', round(left_sbs_mut_age_ml[2]+1.96*left_sbs_mut_age_ml[4],digits=0),']'))

print(paste0('Left ID mutational age : ', round(left_id_mut_age_ml[2],digits=0), ' [', round(left_id_mut_age_ml[2]-1.96*left_id_mut_age_ml[4],digits=1),', ', round(left_id_mut_age_ml[2]+1.96*left_id_mut_age_ml[4],digits=0),']'))


print(paste0('Right SBS mutational age : ', round(right_sbs_mut_age_ml[2],digits=0), ' [', round(right_sbs_mut_age_ml[2]-1.96*right_sbs_mut_age_ml[4],digits=0),', ', round(right_sbs_mut_age_ml[2]+1.96*right_sbs_mut_age_ml[4],digits=0),']'))

print(paste0('Right ID mutational age : ',round(right_id_mut_age_ml[2],digits=0), ' [', round(right_id_mut_age_ml[2]-1.96*right_id_mut_age_ml[4],digits=0),', ', round(right_id_mut_age_ml[2]+1.96*right_id_mut_age_ml[4],digits=0),']'))
```
